newsitem.title: USA: NY Nine Mile Point 2 nuke unit seen back this week.
newsitem.headline: NY Nine Mile Point 2 nuke unit seen back this week.

text.p: The 1,137 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear unit is scheduled to resume operation later this week after being shut Thursday for repairs, the operator said Monday.
"We expect to be in service late this week," said a Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) spokesman.
In Nuclear Regulatory Commission's (NRC) daily plant status report, the Scriba, N.Y., unit was running at less than one-percent power.
Nine Mile Point 2 was shut to inspect the steel beams around the reactors, a NRC spokeswoman said Friday.
The nearby 610 Nine Mile Point unit 1 was running at full output, the NIMO spokesman said.
NIMO operates both Nine Mile Point generating units. It is the sole owner of unit 1 and has a 41 percent stake in unit 2.
New York State Electric and Gas Co and Long Island Lighting Co, each hold 18 percent in unit 2, Rochester Gas and Electric Co (14 percent) and Central Hudson Gas and Electric Co (9 percent).
